info.title: generatejsonschematypes
info.description: Legacy shim for the generatejsonschematypes CLI tool. This tool has been renamed to corvusjson (package: Corvus.Json.Cli). Install the new tool with: dotnet tool install Corvus.Json.Cli. This shim delegates all commands to the same implementation with a deprecation warning.
